{{Top|leg}}
An '''intruder trap''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] device that used a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] with reversed polarity to contain an individual. It would redirect any [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts fired by the captive back to the shooter.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|109|intruder trap}}</ref> Its use was discontinued by 27 BBY due to bystanders being accidentally caught in the trap.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
